2. Daily Summary
Scaffold Site Evaluation – Thursday, October 15, 2026

Arrived at the worksite to inspect and evaluate an area where a potential scaffold installation was being considered. After carefully assessing the available space and the work requirements, I determined that a tube-and-coupler pipe scaffold would be the most suitable option due to the limited working area and the need to safely access elevated sections.

The scaffold would provide the necessary access for the crew to complete the final sheetrock installation, followed by the taping and finishing work. Once all remaining work is completed, the scaffold will be dismantled and removed from the area.
3. Safety Measures Verified
4. Photo Documentation (8 Images)
Mechanical Room – Scaffold Installation Requirements
- Work Area: The mechanical room requires a scaffold installation to provide safe access for the crew to complete the overhead sheetrock installation, followed by the taping and floating work.

- Scaffold Recommendation: A tube-and-coupler (tube-lock) scaffold would be the most suitable option due to the limited working space and the presence of overhead pipes, air ducts, and other mechanical components.

- Purpose: The scaffold will provide the necessary access and working platform for the crew to complete the remaining overhead work safely and efficiently before the scaffold is dismantled and removed.

- Safety Considerations: The scaffold layout must account for existing mechanical systems and restricted clearances. Ensure the scaffold is properly erected, secured, inspected, and equipped with appropriate fall protection and safe access before use.

Leftover Scaffold Parts
- Documented and counted the remaining scaffold components from the previously dismantled scaffold to determine which materials could be reused for the upcoming scaffold build.

- Once the necessary parts have been gathered and delivered to the worksite, I will notify the scaffold crew to proceed with the scaffold installation in the mechanical room, ensuring the setup accommodates the limited space and existing overhead pipes, air ducts, and mechanical equipment.
